sm_top.sm: The U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia announced travel restrictions following Houthi attacks targeting airports and oil facilities.
The U.S. withdrew heavy bombers from RAF Fairford in the United Kingdom following a security incident.
Yemen's Houthis threatened further attacks on Saudi airports and oil infrastructure following a strike.
Russia attacked Ukraine with drones, hitting energy infrastructure and power plants despite ceasefire pushes.
Iran's army claimed an oil tanker was on fire in the Strait of Hormuz.
Seven sailors are missing following a suspected drone attack on tankers in the Black Sea off Romania's coast.
The Saudi-led coalition struck oil facilities west of Yemen's capital.
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps targeted ships with missiles and projectiles in the Strait of Hormuz.
The Saudi-led coalition reported Houthi attacks against the airports of Riyadh and Abha.
The USS Robert Smalls returns to San Diego following a 7-month deployment.
Fighting intensified in Taiz between Yemeni government forces and Houthi fighters.
Ukraine resumed strikes on Russian oil refineries.
Britain announced funding to repair the Chernobyl power plant following a Russian drone strike.
Explosions strike near Yemeni government buildings in Aden.
The MI5 chief stated that Iran is targeting military sites and that a suspected plot at RAF Fairford is not unique.
Malian forces supported by the Africa Corps regained control of Kidal following an extensive air operation.
The United States is considering using the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast bomb in new strike plans against Iran.
A fire breaks out at Saudi Aramco headquarters following an attack.
Houthi rebels reported airstrikes in Yemen amid ongoing regional conflict developments.
A ship caught fire in the Black Sea near Romania, prompting an investigation into a possible drone strike.
Saudi authorities opened a probe into how defense systems failed to stop a Houthi attack on Riyadh airport.
Ukrainian strikes targeted Russian data centers, posing significant challenges.
Russian drone debris damaged contemporary artwork at a museum in Lutsk.
Moscow was targeted by a massive drone attack, with air defense systems shooting down drones overnight as airports temporarily closed.
Israeli attacks and gunfire killed two Palestinians and injured others in Gaza in ceasefire violations.
The Ukrainian Air Force reported that Russia launched attack drones and missiles.
Ukrainian missile strikes hit a Russian military airfield, destroying several Su-34 jets.
NATO launched its annual Steadfast Noon nuclear exercise in Italy with 17 nations participating.
Drones strike tankers near Romania's Black Sea coast, leaving sailors missing.
A Russian drone attack on Kropyvnytskyi killed three people.
Russian strikes leave 600,000 residents in Ukraine without electricity.
Missiles hit Kyiv as Ukraine accused the US of helping Russia.
Russian airstrikes on Kramatorsk caused deaths and injuries.
Moscow reported an overnight attack involving nearly 500 drones, leading to the suspension of operations at four airports.
Iran launched ballistic missiles during military drills amid tensions with the United States.
A Boko Haram attack on a military base in Borno State killed soldiers and civilians.
A Russian attack on Kirovohrad Oblast killed three people and injured six others.
The Pentagon is sending a third aircraft carrier strike group and additional Marines to the Middle East.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes hit oil facilities in Yemen, prompting Houthi warnings of retaliation.
Sirens and explosions were reported in Najran and Jazan amid Houthi attacks.
